dct_description_sm: Emergency and essential-health facilities for the Caracas area of Venezuela (bounding box 67.09W-66.65W, 10.28N-10.64N), captured for the M 7.5 earthquake response. Includes hospitals, emergency rooms, medical centres, pharmacies, fire, police, and ambulance/EMS services. Sourced from the Overture Maps places theme (Meta, Foursquare, Microsoft, AllThePlaces). This data is not from OpenStreetMap and complements the OSM-based exports. Event: M 7.5 Earthquake, west of Caracas. - Source: [Overture Maps](https://overturemaps.org/) - Part of HOT disaster response exports on HDX by [HOT](https://www.hotosm.org/)
